$schema_note: Agentic OS plugin manifest v1 (2026-04-24). Lists plugins this repo expects/uses. Install by reference (not copy) per v5.3 Council decision. Run `py -3 .claude/tools/install_plugins.py` to install all 'core' plugins; append `--all` for core+optional.

claude-plugins-official.note: Anthropic-maintained official plugins. Each carries its own LICENSE upstream.

voltagent-subagents.note: 92 domain specialists we route to via SPECIALISTS.md.

core.$comment: Plugins this repo actively relies on. Expected to be installed on every machine running this project.

commit-commands@claude-plugins-official.why: We ship /commit, /commit-push-pr, /clean_gone commands derived from this plugin. Install the source for updates + parity.

security-guidance@claude-plugins-officia.why: Source of security_reminder_hook.py (we use a Windows-portable + Agentic-OS-aware copy in .claude/hooks/). Install for upstream pattern updates.

claude-md-management@claude-plugins-offi.why: Long-term constitution maintenance (claude-md-improver skill). Referenced by our onboarding.

voltagent-lang@voltagent-subagents.why: 30 language specialists (python-pro, typescript-pro, rust-engineer, golang-pro, etc.). Routed to per SPECIALISTS.md.

voltagent-dev-exp@voltagent-subagents.why: 15 dev-experience specialists (refactoring, legacy-modernizer, mcp-developer, documentation-engineer, etc.).

voltagent-qa-sec@voltagent-subagents.why: 16 QA + security specialists (security-auditor, penetration-tester, performance-engineer, test-automator, etc.). Heavy use in Council loops.

voltagent-data-ai@voltagent-subagents.why: 14 data + ML specialists (ai-engineer, llm-architect, postgres-pro, database-optimizer, etc.).

superpowers@claude-plugins-official.why: Substantive skills: using-superpowers, brainstorming, writing-plans, systematic-debugging, test-driven-development, verification-before-completion, subagent-driven-development, requesting/receiving-code-review, dispatching-parallel-agents, finishing-a-development-branch. Core discipline patterns that complement our Council flow. Note: the plugin's legacy slash commands (/brainstorm, /write-plan, /execute-plan) are upstream-deprecated shims — ignore those; use the SKILLS.

optional.$comment: Useful in specific contexts. Install on demand.

feature-dev@claude-plugins-official.why: 3 agents (code-architect, code-explorer, code-reviewer) for structured feature workflow.
feature-dev@claude-plugins-official.when: Starting a greenfield feature and want a blueprint-first approach.

mcp-server-dev@claude-plugins-official.when: Extending the project with new MCP integrations.

code-review@claude-plugins-official.why: Standalone code-review workflow (complements our /review + Consensus Council).
code-review@claude-plugins-official.when: Want an extra independent review pass.

agent-sdk-dev@claude-plugins-official.why: Help building with Claude Agent SDK.
agent-sdk-dev@claude-plugins-official.when: Building programmatic agents outside this repo's subagent system.

session-report@claude-plugins-official.when: Heavy long-session work where reports add value.

ralph-loop@claude-plugins-official.why: Autonomous-loop scaffolding (one of the continuous-loop patterns).

pr-review-toolkit@claude-plugins-officia.when: Regular PR-review cadence on a team.

language-lsps.$comment: Language Server Protocol integrations. Install ONLY the ones matching your project's languages.

styles.$comment: Output-style plugins. Install at most one; they modify Claude's response format.

explanatory-output-style@claude-plugins-.why: Verbose explanatory mode — useful for teaching/onboarding sessions.

learning-output-style@claude-plugins-off.why: Structured learning mode — useful when using Claude to study a new topic.

skip.$comment: Plugins we do NOT recommend + why.

math-olympiad@claude-plugins-official.why_skip: Math-competition specific. Install only if doing math work.

code-simplifier@claude-plugins-official.why_skip: Covered by voltagent-dev-exp:refactoring-specialist (broader + already in specialist pool).

claude-code-setup@claude-plugins-officia.why_skip: Initial Claude Code install. Not relevant after first setup.
